priorities.summary: Improper authentication in Progress WS_FTP Server versions before 2024.0.6 and 2025.0.3 on Windows allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to access sensitive information, including administrative credentials. Update to WS_FTP Server 2024.0.6 or 2025.0.3.

A stack-based buffer overflow in the TFTP upload filename handler of D-Link DIR-505 firmware 1.10B02 can be triggered remotely, and a public exploit is available. The affected device is an end-of-life consumer router; replace or isolate affected units, as no vendor fix is indicated in the CVE record.

JavaNativeMessageDecoder in the inactive Apache MINA 3.0 codec module calls ObjectInputStream.readObject() on frame bytes with no class filter, allowing gadget-chain remote code execution when an application puts it in front of an untrusted peer. The 3.0 branch will not be fixed; use the latest Apache MINA 2.2.x branch instead.

model.name: Apple Intelligence in China with Alibaba's Qwen
model.summary: Apple confirmed on October 31 that Apple Intelligence will reach mainland China, with testing from November 4 in the latest iOS developer beta and a public launch with iOS 27.3 in December. Alibaba's Qwen model will power selected experiences — Siri, Writing Tools and Visual Intelligence — in place of ChatGPT, while the rebuilt Siri AI is not included in this first release.
